column1: I've always heard such nice things about policemen. But now I see where the nick-name 'pig' comes from.
column2: 「我一直聽說警察很好。但現在我知道『豬』這個綽號是怎麼來的了。」

column1: Why you filthy little sniveling creep!
column2: 「你這骯髒、愛哭的小爬蟲！」

column1: If I weren't a LADY, I'd...!
column2: 「如果我不是淑女，我就會……！」

column1: Why you slimy little SQUID!
column2: 「你這滑溜的小魷魚！」

column1: In an excited voice the woman says... "I was jogging along the river's edge, and...and I came across something that looked like blood..."
column2: 女人興奮地說……「我沿著河邊慢跑，然後……我遇到一些看起來像血的東西……」

column1: Continuing, she says, "I stopped to look, and right next to the blood, I saw marks that looked like something had been dragged into the river. And... and footprints -- I saw footprints!"
column2: 她繼續說：「我停下查看，就在血旁邊看見像是有東西被拖進河裡的痕跡。還有……還有腳印——我看到了腳印！」

column1: You attempt to interrupt, but she keeps rolling it out as she says... "I got scared when I heard the brush crack, so I ran down here and called the Police."
column2: 你試圖打斷她，但她繼續滔滔不絕地說……「聽到灌木折斷的聲音時我嚇壞了，所以跑到這裡報警。」

column1: The jogger says... "Officer, please go look! I hope nothing bad has happened."
column2: 慢跑者說……「警官，請去看看！希望沒有發生壞事。」

column1: The girl answers..."Not me! I'm not going back there!" she says, "I'll tell you where it is, but I'm not going!"
column2: 女孩回答……「我才不要！我不回去！」她說：「我會告訴你在哪裡，但我不去！」

column1: The jogger, frightened by the gunfire, runs away.
column2: 慢跑者被槍聲嚇到，跑掉了。

column1: Keith says... "I'm right behind you partner."
column2: 基斯說……「我就在你後面，夥伴。」

column1: We've radioed for the diver, Sonny, and he'll be here shortly, Keith volunteers.
column2: 「我們已經用無線電叫潛水員了，桑尼，他很快就會到。」基斯主動說。

column1: Hey, Sonny! Keith shouts, "We can't leave yet. We haven't checked everything out."
column2: 「嘿，桑尼！」基斯喊道：「我們還不能走。我們還沒檢查完。」

column1: As you inspect the evidence, Keith ambles into view...
column2: 你檢查證物時，基斯慢慢走進視線……

column1: Keith pipes up, "Hey! Look at that. I'll bet Bains snuffed that poor jailer and then threw the body into the river."
column2: 基斯插話說：「嘿！看那個。我敢打賭班恩斯殺了可憐的獄警，再把屍體丟進河裡。」

column1: You take care of the evidence, and I'll go radio a request for the dive team.
column2: 「你處理證物，我去用無線電申請潛水隊。」

column1: Well, there he is, grunts Officer Moore. "I found him wedged in some rocks."
column2: 「他就在那裡，」摩爾警官哼道。「我在一些岩石間找到他。」

column1: It's not a pretty sight, eh, Sonny?
column2: 「景象不太好看，對吧，桑尼？」

column1: Did you forget something, Sonny? Officer Moore asks.
column2: 「你忘了什麼嗎，桑尼？」摩爾警官問。

column1: It looks as though Officer Moore has decided to stay down a little longer.
column2: 看來摩爾警官決定再待在水下久一點。

column1: See ya, Sonny! Officer Moore shouts after you. "I'll stay here with the body."
column2: 「回頭見，桑尼！」摩爾警官對你喊道。「我會和屍體留在這裡。」

column1: Officer Moore says, "Talk to Gelepsi, I'm staying here."
column2: 摩爾警官說：「去和傑列普西談，我留在這裡。」

column1: Keith says, "Let's find a body first!"
column2: 基斯說：「我們先找到屍體再說！」

column1: There is no need to call the coroner.
column2: 不需要叫法醫。

column1: Yeah, maybe you overlooked some evidence.
column2: 「對，也許你漏掉了一些證物。」
